digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM model-class configuration and resolution
propositions: Model tier selection is inferred from an equality test against the framework default rather than expressible as config, so the Pass-2/Pass-4 and completion verifier downgrades silently stop applying for any non-default (Bedrock) model.

Introduce three capability class slots (trivial, standard, frontier) that every rebar LLM call site resolves against, each filled by operator config with model/provider/endpoint and an optional fallback chain, replacing a single scalar knob for four passes.

code-review.yaml declares no model on any step and plan-review.yaml uses bare claude names that map to provider anthropic, causing Bedrock runs to route Pass-1 finders to direct Anthropic (a split-brain).

REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE layers over discovered config with deep table merge (leaf key wins) and wholesale array replacement (fallback = [] disables fallbacks), without modifying the shared shallow-merge read_reserved_section helper.

Class names are reserved values in the existing model/model_ladder string space (no schema change), resolved at runtime via a single model_classes.resolve_model_string function called at three call sites: config.resolve_model, ladder expansion, and the verifier path.

sizing.MODEL_LADDER hardcodes bare Anthropic names and its substring match returns those names, so a Bedrock run that escalates silently jumps to direct Anthropic opus and must be fixed in the same change.
